title: Molecular Phenotypes for Cystic Fibrosis Lung Disease
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to develop an integrated view of molecular mechanisms underlying CF lung disease severity.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with CF
* Participation in Genetic Modifiers of CF Lung Disease study (NCT00037765)

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of lung transplant
* Fully anticoagulated or clotting abnormalities
* Large nosebleed in the last 2 months
* Acutely ill
study_population: CF patients who have the same CFTR genetic background, i.e., homozygous deltaF508, and who are at the extremes of pulmonary phenotype, i.e., the most severe and mildest lung disease.
